name: Kuwait eVisa (visit)
summary: Online visa for short sightseeing, business or family visits for eligible nationalities. Apply on the Ministry of Interior portal within one month before travel.

other: Only some nationalities qualify. Kuwait's embassy lists them at the linked page.
Passport valid more than 6 months with two blank facing pages.

stay.note: Up to 3 months from entry, per the Kuwait embassy in Japan.

fees.label: eVisa fee (as listed by the Kuwait embassy in Japan)

sources.label: Kuwait Embassy in Japan, visa info
Kuwait Embassy in Washington, eVisa and visa on arrival countries

name: Kuwait visa on arrival
summary: Citizens of a listed set of countries can get a visa on arrival or use the eVisa. Entry can be refused without explanation.

other: The Washington embassy page lists these countries for visa on arrival or eVisa. Which one applies to each was not stated there.
Passport valid more than 6 months with two blank facing pages.
Must not be on a blacklist. Register an address at the airport visa counter.

stay.note: Single entry, 3 months from entry, per the Kuwait embassy in Japan (Japanese nationals).

fees.label: Visa on arrival fee (subject to change)

sources.label: Kuwait Embassy in Washington, eVisa and visa on arrival countries
Kuwait Embassy in Japan, visa info

name: Sponsor-arranged visit visa
summary: If you can't get an eVisa or visa on arrival, a sponsor in Kuwait applies for your visa through the Ministry of Interior.

sources.label: Kuwait Embassy in Japan, visa info

name: Kuwait work visa (sponsored)
summary: A sponsor in Kuwait applies for you. You need the electronic visa, a medical certificate and a police clearance, both legalized.

other: Medical certificate (HIV, hepatitis B and C, chest X-ray) and police clearance, valid 3 months at entry. Details come from the Japan embassy page, other embassies may differ.

sources.label: Kuwait Embassy in Japan, visa info

name: Kuwait family visa
summary: For family of someone in Kuwait. Needs the electronic visa, application form, photo and medical certificate. Adults also need police clearance.

other: Children 5 to 11 need a vaccination record.
Police clearance for ages 18 and over, issued within 3 months of entry.

sources.label: Kuwait Embassy in Japan, visa info
